a: USD 75K-150K for 12 months (paid in local currency), plus compute and API credits
dt: Apply by Oct 31, 2026 (foundation site; the AJO form lists Nov 7); first cohort starts Jan 2027, three cohorts a year
e: Twelve-month, remote, full-time fellowship that funds physicists to do their own research project using AI and to document their AI workflow openly. Open to senior postdocs, research scientists, junior faculty, independent researchers and strong late-stage PhD students; no citizenship limits stated.
unv: The AJO deadline field says Nov 7, 2026, but the foundation's program page and the ad text say Oct 31, 2026. No time of day is stated.
